rosters.cannotEstablish: whether the player dresses, or how much he plays
rosters.rights: keyless public JSON, point-in-time, attributed, facts only

injuries.establishes: a published injury designation when one exists
injuries.cannotEstablish: health in the absence of a designation — silence is not a clean bill
injuries.rights: keyless public JSON, designations only; editorial prose is never stored

gameDayActives.cannotEstablish: everything — no authorized source carries the official inactive list
gameDayActives.nextObservationWindow: ~90 minutes before kickoff, if a rights-cleared source is ever added

snapScripting.cannotEstablish: preseason series/snap plans are not published by anyone

honesty: a roster spot is not evidence of playing time, and absence from an injury report is not evidence of health
ACTIVE_EXPECTED is unreachable today by construction: no authorized source carries the official game-day inactive list
NOT_YET_PUBLISHED names a real future observation window; UNSUPPORTED means no source exists at all — they are different answers

events.verdictReason: no event-bound active evidence is available from an authorized source
events.nextObservationWindow: ~90 minutes before 2026-10-12T00:20Z, if a rights-cleared actives source is added
